difficulty_standard.overall: Above typical recent UPSC difficulty, while fair, syllabus-relevant and unambiguous.
difficulty_standard.prelims: Multi-statement elimination, close conceptual distinctions, cross-subject integration, map/institution/application reasoning and balanced plausible distractors; no niche fact dumping.
difficulty_standard.csat: Moderately harder than the recent qualifying level through dense passages, time pressure and multi-step reasoning; every item remains uniquely solvable without gratuitous calculation.
difficulty_standard.mains: Synthesis, critique, competing viewpoints, constitutional/institutional or evidence-based analysis, qualification and current-static integration.
difficulty_standard.philosophy: Textual and doctrinal precision, argument reconstruction, objections and strongest replies, and comparisons across thinkers or schools.
difficulty_standard.qualifying_language: Matriculation-level language skills tested through demanding but fair comprehension, precis, composition, translation and usage tasks.
